title: The v1 '>20 solar masses' formation rule is unsourced
summary: The older article's stellar-mass threshold and Cygnus X-1 confirmation were not matched to a paper in this pass.
body: The v1 black-hole article said stellar black holes form when stars above 20 solar masses die, and it named Cygnus X-1 as the first confirmed black hole. Those specific claims were not tied to a paper or a NASA sentence opened in this pass. Formation thresholds depend on stellar models and are revised. Leave both claims unsourced until a named source is attached. Supermassive-black-hole formation is also described in the v1 text as still debated; that open question is real in the literature, but this card does not invent a citation for the debate.

legacy.note: v1 truthScore and source-count fields are not evidence and are not copied.
